feature_inventory.scope: implemented compiler language-output admission, independent of simulator/tool observations

admission_semantics.direct: Operation-name admission only; native semantic, type, effect, placement and rendering checks remain mandatory.
admission_semantics.guarded: Admitted only by the named existing context-sensitive validator; never a direct allowlist entry.
admission_semantics.normalize: Source-only form requiring a documented implemented lowering before operation admission; no current operation uses this category.
admission_semantics.unsupported: No current backend emission path; no fallback, omission or approximation.

feature_inventory.domain_semantics: Neutral operations require caller-owned actual-IR type classification. Mixed means intrinsically analog and digital; arbitrary bridge kind strings do not establish it.

features.summary: Cross, above, timer, lifecycle events and event-controlled statements
constraints: Exactly the native cross, above, timer, initial_step, final_step and any-of event contracts within a verified analog procedure.
Owned source expressions, analysis filters, event/storage effects and generated placement rules are checked; digital event scheduling and arbitrary wait/delay are unsupported.

features.summary: Continuous scalar expressions and authored contributions
constraints: Typed Real/Integer/Boolean forms, exact units and owned analog-region placements must pass native verification.
Division, nonfinite values, residual/contribution semantics and independently verified quantity erasure remain enforced; typed source equations are not emitted by this feature.

features.summary: Closed active-analysis and simulator-context queries
constraints: Active analysis IDs come from analog-functions-v1.json#analyses; time is mapped separately by analog_abstime.
Ambient temperature is kelvin. Nominal temperature requires the consumer tnom parameter in Celsius and is converted to kelvin without a fallback.
Frequency, operating_condition, corner, sweep_coordinate and random_seed providers are unavailable; registry presence does not admit those queries.

features.summary: Scalar and shaped conservative terminals, nodes, branches and bindings
constraints: Verified conservative endpoints and actual net relations only; discipline, direction, orientation and floating-terminal rules remain active.
Shaped bindings use the existing conservative shape/projection proofs and bounded target layouts; arbitrary dynamic topology is unsupported.

features.summary: Source-semantic ddt and idt operators
constraints: Only the finite validated operator contracts, dimensions, initialization/reset variants and legal static/generated placements; history cannot be folded, CSEd or moved across effect boundaries.

features.summary: Digital connectivity, clock/reset domains and state machines
constraints: No digital HDL implementation is advertised by the current analog backend, including when verilog-ams is selected.

The Verilog-A early language gate also inspects actual carrier types and every emitted hierarchy definition, including unused definitions; a neutral operation name or stale summary cannot hide digital values.

features.summary: Continuous reads of independently proven event-held real storage
constraints: Only owner-correlated Real storage with independently verified event-held initialization and writes; arbitrary persistent variables are not admitted by the operation name.

features.summary: Closed version-1 mathematical function registry
constraints: Only registered functions and their exact arities, dimension rules and finite-domain checks; the registry is authoritative rather than an open function-name escape.

features.summary: Bridge records awaiting explicit backend lowering
constraints: Bridge records are analog-domain metadata by name; an arbitrary kind string is not authoritative proof of digital behavior.
Actual digital carrier types are rejected by the Verilog-A gate. No bridge record is emitted by the current backend admission path.

features.summary: Declared or imported analog natures and disciplines
constraints: Only independently verified nature/discipline identities, access functions and dimensions; imported declarations are not automatically simulator-provided.

features.summary: White, flicker and tabulated analog noise
constraints: Exactly white (one density), flicker (density and constant dimensionless exponent), or table (constant frequency/density pairs).
Finite typed operands, nonnegative known densities, unique nonnegative table frequencies and ownership are checked; noise-modulated noise is unsupported.

features.summary: Typed parameters, constant-expression DAGs, bounds and overrides
constraints: Existing parameter kinds, units, finite envelopes, source ownership and constant-expression verification remain mandatory.
Structural bounds must hold for every legal parameter setting; defaults are not proofs.

features.summary: Verified component contracts and finite partial topology records
constraints: component_contract must pass its native verifier. connection_set/flow_conservation require a partial physical component, complete=false and their native verifier.
potential_equality requires a verified partial component record and an independently proven actual equal net relation; no additional numeric contribution is emitted.
Complete equation/topology lowering is not provided by these metadata records.

features.summary: Potential and flow reads on verified conservative endpoints
constraints: The existing potential/flow normalization and independent normalized-model checks are required; access support placements and orientation may not be forged.

features.summary: Verified derived flow probe records
constraints: Only derived probes accepted by verifyPotentialFlowAccessOperation and the normalized model; a named record alone does not admit a probe.

features.summary: Finite structured analog if/case/loop and lexical exits
constraints: Only operations accepted within verifyAnalogProcedureTarget; no generic procedural HDL escape.
Generated procedures admit at most one nonnested runtime loop, no loop-local declarations, and only the existing direct control/scope/exit placements.
Generated non-event loops require owned Integer bounds and retain stricter conditional/case and exit limits; event procedures use their separately checked placement profile.

features.summary: Verified analog procedure regions and ordered scalar/shaped storage
constraints: Every operation must belong to one procedure accepted by verifyAnalogProcedureTarget, including source-expression, storage-reference and generated-owner validation.
Assignments require guard_present=false and exactly the dc/transient analysis pair. Storage projections and snapshots must resolve through the native storage model.

Declarations nested inside generated procedural loops and unverified persistent initialization are unsupported. Structural generated occurrence-local declarations remain supported by their existing ownership/initializer checks; array layout/cardinality and live-consumer budget checks remain active.

features.summary: Context-sensitive conservative or procedural shape projections
constraints: shape_index/view/slice require a resolvable conservative shape or storage/value projection within a verified analog procedure; the operation name does not establish its domain.
Outside procedures, nodal.constant is admitted only as one nonempty-use index result whose users are verified conservative shape_index or shape_slice operations.
Digital ports, dynamic shapes, unproved bounds/cardinalities and unsupported projection compositions do not gain admission.

features.summary: Source-only topology forms without current backend admission
constraints: These operations have source/native semantics but are not admitted by the current backend operation verifier; no implicit normalization-to-supported claim.

features.summary: Modules, static generation and analog instance hierarchy
constraints: Analog definitions and statically bounded generate domains only; every emitted definition is checked independently, including unused definitions.

Generated domains, owner identities, binding cardinalities and target signed-integer bounds must satisfy the existing hierarchy renderer; no parameter-default specialization or eager expansion is implied.

features.summary: Transition, slew, absolute delay, absolute time and step bounds
constraints: Existing exact operator arities, dimensions, continuity, initialization and placement contracts apply.
Time observation, timestep control and history remain effects; a language mapping does not establish consumer support.

features.summary: Finite laplace_nd and zi_nd transfer contracts
constraints: Only laplace_nd with ascending_s coefficients and zi_nd with ascending_z_inverse coefficients; both use simulator-default initialization.
Nonempty static coefficient arrays and proven nonzero constant denominator d0 are required; zi_nd has one to three proven constant time arguments.
Explicit epsilon, initial_value and alternative transfer spellings/policies are unsupported.

features.summary: Typed unknown/equation structural analysis without HDL lowering
constraints: Typed equations and any source_equations-marked IR require equation-to-target lowering; structural matching is not HDL emission.
Rejected with NODAL-BACKEND-EQUATION-134-001 rather than erased or approximated.

features.summary: Shared IR surfaces without current analog target lowering
constraints: Native/source representation alone does not establish backend emission; each listed operation remains rejected until an explicit lowering is implemented.
Interface and shape carriers need type-sensitive classification; neutral means shared representation, not permission to emit digital behavior.

features.summary: Typed module-local pure nonrecursive functions
constraints: Only the existing isolated typed scalar function contract and total return profile; no recursion, simulator reads, mutable state or implicit function-call elimination.

language_profiles.implementation_scope: verified analog emission; digital and mixed-signal lowering remain unsupported
verified analog emission; digital and mixed-signal lowering remain unsupported

feature_inventory.consumer_observation_policy: Observations are tied to one exact witness, consumer version and language profile; successful internal reparse or one independent compile never establishes feature-wide simulator support.

consumer_observations.detail: This exact generated model was rejected at its named child-module instance; no hierarchy-wide or other-consumer conclusion follows.
This exact scalar initial-step, Boolean/Integer control and held-Real witness compiled. No array, other event form, feature-wide support or numerical execution claim follows.
